title: Real-time sales copilot: a sidecar that rides a human call and surfaces objection playbooks on the rep's screen
alias: real-time agent assist for sales calls
summary: A sales copilot demo built to show an ai_sidecar listening to both legs of a human call without speaking. A code classifier decides the objection category, and the talk tracks go only to the rep's page, never into the prompt.
scenario: A customer talks to a human rep; when they raise a pricing, timing, competitor or authority objection, a talk-track card appears within a turn
